info.cls_ename: Master's Program, Department of Communications Engineering

description.describe_ch: 本課程針對新型態的行動通訊網路應用，介紹5G新的以雲端服務及智慧物聯網為基礎的核心系統架構，並探討如何在行動核心網路的信賴區或外部授權區開發新的核網應用服務。
description.describe_eh: This course aims at new types of mobile communication network applications, and introduces the new core system architecture based on cloud services and intelligent Internet of Things, and discusses how to develop new application services in the trusted zone or external authorized zone of the Core Network.

targets.describe_ch: 了解5G行動通訊的核心網路架構
targets.describe_en: To understand the core network architecture of the 5G mobile communication.

targets.describe_ch: 了解5G核網相關的應用服務
targets.describe_en: To understand the application services of the 5G core network.

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
1. 同學應準時出席上課，出席紀錄列入平時成績計算。
2. 同學在課堂上都應尊重每個人，上課時請勿講話影響他人。
3. 要確保在上課時，將手機調整為靜音。
4. 不得戴耳機上課。

4. 不得戴耳機上課。

Class Rules and Reminders

Students should attend class on time; attendance is factored into the regular grade.
Students must respect everyone in the classroom and avoid talking or disturbing others during class.
Ensure that mobile phones are set to silent mode during class.
Wearing earphones during class is not permitted.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem: 老師在學期初提供預訂教學進度表給同學作參考，但實際教學進度可能會隨同學的學習狀況適度調整，確定的考試時間會於上課時公布。
